what: Keep the system cursor as is. Four 10px corner brackets follow around the cursor (left·top −12px, right·bottom +2px) with a .16s lag (faint, .45). Over links, buttons and list rows they spread out to the corners 6px outside that box over .36s, snap on and darken. Curve .16,1,.3,1, with difference blending so they stay visible over photos and dark bands

options.gap: Outer box margin when sticking (px), default 6
options.idle: Opacity when attached to nothing, default .45
options.targets: Selectors to pin (comma-separated, earlier ones first), default [data-fx-part=row], a, button

from.where: shared.js brackets() (.cursor-brackets — four-corner brackets attached to work rows · note rows · links · buttons)
